Markets.title: US stocks: US market slips as oil prices rise, retail results awaited
Markets.summary: US stock indexes fell as investors awaited major retail earnings reports and oil prices surged due to supply uncertainties. Technology stocks, however, bucked the downward trend amid cautious market conditions.

Markets.title: Gold appears set for a rebound as it regains safe-haven appeal after US-Iran war selloff
Markets.summary: Gold has recovered nine percent following a recent selloff, driven by renewed safe-haven demand, institutional buying, and favorable inflation data. While stalled peace efforts could support further gains, weak demand may limit future price increases.

Markets.title: Gold rises as weaker dollar, fading Fed hike bets lift demand
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose on Monday due to a weaker U.S. dollar and reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. Investors also monitored Middle East geopolitical tensions for potential market impacts.

Markets.title: Copper hits over six-month high as LME supply concerns mount
Markets.summary: Copper prices reached a six-month high on Monday due to a significant drop in London Metal Exchange inventories. Other industrial metals also gained value as the U.S. dollar weakened.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their losses for a fifth consecutive session, with the Sensex falling 281 points amid bearish market breadth. Analysts report that crude prices, Strait of Hormuz tensions, and upcoming Federal Reserve minutes will be the key drivers for Tuesday's market action.

Markets.title: ICICI Bank raises $750 million as Indian banks tap dollar bond market
Markets.summary: ICICI Bank raised $750 million through a five-year dollar bond issuance. This marks the bank's second international bond offering in the past month as other Indian lenders also prepare similar debt sales.

Geo-Political.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal

Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for primary articles and manufactured products both increased compared to June.
